---
title: "stage_6_suitabiliy_vs_abundance"
author: "Shahar Chaikin"
date: "2025-11-15"
output: html_document
---

Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load abundance output
```{r}
abundance_trends=read_rds("abundance_pred/slopes_df_l_ocellata.rds")
```

Climatic SDM output
```{r}
sdm_trends=read_rds("predictions/habitat-suitability-slopes.rds")
```

Crop based on the abundance output
```{r}
abund_suit_trends=abundance_trends %>% 
  select(h3_id,
         slope_ab=slope,
         slope_se_ab=slope_se) %>% 
  mutate(scaled_slope_ab=scale(slope_ab) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  left_join(sdm_trends %>% 
              select(h3_id,
                     slope_sdm=estimate,
                     slope_se_sdm=std.error) %>% 
              mutate(scaled_slope_sdm=scale(slope_sdm)%>% as.numeric()),
            by="h3_id")
```

Plot relationship
```{r}
abund_suit_trends_lm=lm(data=abund_suit_trends,
                        formula = scaled_slope_ab~scaled_slope_sdm)
summary(abund_suit_trends_lm)
abund_suit_trends$scaled_slope_sdm %>% min
abund_suit_trends$scaled_slope_sdm %>% max

#performance::check_model(abund_suit_trends_lm)
abund_suit_trends_lm_gg=ggeffects::ggpredict(abund_suit_trends_lm,
                                             terms= "scaled_slope_sdm [-1.61:1.037 by=0.01]")

#Sclaed
abund_suit_trends_p=ggplot(data=abund_suit_trends)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,linetype=2,color = "grey")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,linetype=2,color = "grey")+
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black",alpha=0.4)+
  geom_point(aes(y=scaled_slope_ab,
                 x=scaled_slope_sdm),
             color="grey")+
  geom_line(data=abund_suit_trends_lm_gg,
            aes(x=x,y=predicted))+
  labs(x="Change in habitat suitability (scaled)",
       y="Change in abundance (scaled)")+
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-2,5),
                  ylim=c(-2,5))+
  theme_classic()
abund_suit_trends_p

ggsave(plot = abund_suit_trends_p,
       filename = "abund_suit_trends_p.png",
       device = "jpeg",width = 15,height = 10,units = "cm")
```
